Preparation rehearsal checkpoint (2026-08-24, nonmutating): frozen source fba1098902f1e8943b259fe16dd08167dc69bb7b, candidate a5c8d7400232d6e6e709a9a1d5df4094a63ee926, candidate tree 8689cba43eb3af8de6c88f9fc3faded0a03a8cd4, manifest digest bcdf7f38178418ac8df10869ee65bf0c267fae67933c5ed3ff6bb46b32bcc563. The verified rewrite removes 760 manifest COMMENT aliases/events and 254,356,959 logical bytes. Whole-store replay passed for 5,385 tickets; all 5,382 unaffected states are identical, the three target states equal the exact manifest subtraction, six Jira-backed survivors remain, bindings are byte-identical, and fsck/topology/metadata/ref checks pass. Checkout allocation falls by about 255.6 MB. Important caveat: the reachable pack grows from about 347 MB to 575 MB and a new whole clone saves only about 26 MB; logical payload removal must not be represented as equivalent pack savings.

The digest-bound Jira cleanup passed the stateful success and crash/resume rehearsals: exact canary order, one attempt per target, durable intent/outcome journal, exact six survivors, and non-target byte/identity parity. No DELETE reached Jira.

The initial candidate oracle found three description-only updates on 8625-7bea-67db-4cdc/REB-1567, 9305-b42c-3262-4c58/REB-1931, and e27c-5a20-cd13-43b2/REB-2605. Investigation proved these are pre-existing rich-text cutover drift: current old source and candidate emit the identical plan, current bindings retain the older description baseline shape, and scheduled Reconcile Bridge run 32780175915 again omitted all three targets and left those baselines unchanged. Consistent with paramount-ducal-snake, the codec/soft-wrap migrations, and crusty-jovial-wren, preparation does not add a binding migration, weaken comparison, or manually converge Jira descriptions.

The corrected differential oracle passed. Independently inspected canonical plan SHA-256: 8004f77be6b1afe1da1dafde1c55a14ab0c34a40b41bb9c0a9fee8b29eaf80fa. Old and candidate full plans are identical: exactly three outbound updates, expected target/local bindings, description as the only changed field, and empty comments/labels/links. Two candidate observations are identical, each reports 3 deferred and 0 applied/failed; transport write calls are empty; HEAD, tree, bindings, tracked-file count, tracked logical bytes, and tracked-byte digest remain unchanged. Private mode-0600 receipts are under /Users/joeoakhart/rebar-comment-echo-rehearsal.1AoCDN. The runbook now regenerates and pins this differential before Jira DELETE and rejects every collection operation, extra target/field/payload, or old-versus-candidate scalar difference. The digest is comparison evidence only and does not authorize applying the descriptions.

No workflow state, Jira comment, authoritative tickets ref, writer, lease, or persistent clone was mutated. Remaining preparation work: repository gates, update/rebase onto current origin/main, Gerrit review/CI/submit, then stop and notify the operator that the quiet-window execution ticket can be scheduled.
